answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric attestation creates Sybil resistance by anchoring agent identities to unique physical traits. The system utilizes a cryptographic beacon to signal periodic validation windows, ensuring each session remains clear as crystal. If an attacker attempts to inject a zephyr of artificial clones, the resource-intensive verification protocol forces them to procure valid human credentials for every node, effectively raising the capital cost of identity fabrication beyond the expected utility.
